finalText:
**380 commits, 13 user-visible changes.** Wrote them into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md#L3).

Four are breaking. The `v1` export route is gone. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. Internal error types are no longer re-exported. Latency histogram units changed, so dashboards need rescaling.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Eight fix groups.

Next: check the min node version. Docs note it five times. No `engines` bump appears anywhere.
